transitions.summary: When higher sanction turns away from established power, movement shifts southward; measured ceremony restores public calm and brings armed struggle to a close.
Shared wine, laughter, music, and dance create a ceremonial happiness that culminates in a humble reception of favor.
Sound embankments keep water within limits, while full illumination sends the cicada back to its native concealment; containment and timely withdrawal preserve order.
A ruler muddies the realm like a struggling fish, yet a royal departure toward delight meets a fortunate opening and an apparently blessed course.
A birth expands friendship and benefit under favorable sanction, while the appended journey introduces arduous service and a distant search for higher favor.
A failing country loses the support that could stabilize it, leaving disturbance to repeat without an interval for recovery.
Many young share one nurturing source and remain pliant toward one another, allowing consultation, safety, and long continuity to grow from family cohesion.
Moral excellence becomes its own protection and attracts recognition without aggressive pursuit, so standing emerges as a consequence of cultivated quality.
Equal powers injure one another in direct struggle, yet the encounter ends through separation rather than enduring resentment or renewed attack.
A culture hero’s ordered journey brings widespread rejoicing, though unrelated appended images of drivers, blame, and failed commerce make the entry internally discontinuous.
A meeting spreads benefit and fitting words in every direction, yet the quoted missed appointment leaves a subtle tension between celebration and lateness.
A great predator prepares to strike, but an unlikely smaller creature frightens it away, allowing the vulnerable herd to feed safely.
A water creature rejects the environment that sustains it and continues over dry land until body, place, and opportunity are all lost.
Artificial brightness extends the day but fixation on what has passed weakens active authority, allowing receptive forces to become proud and ungovernable.
Predatory forces enter the settled center seeking consumption, but capable leadership stands firm and prevents the community from being lost.
Movement follows the sun’s appointed rhythms without missing its times, joining temporal discipline with civic peace and freedom from disruption.
Harvest and reward arrive without corresponding labor, but excess beyond merit cannot hold; vehicle, house, and office all give way.
Founders of new orders endure imprisonment under failing regimes, while ordinary nourishment and the people’s joy quietly anticipate a change in mandate.
Work begins before dawn beneath scattered stars, yet strenuous movement brings no recognized result and leaves only the bitterness of unrewarded effort.
Affection and marriage plans become tied to hopes of wealth, but the anticipated gain reverses into impoverishment when relationship is treated as acquisition.
Energetic travel toward a hospitable household is met with a warm garment and continuing good fortune, joining initiative with generous reception.
When altruism is attacked and ethical power injured, blessing withdraws and the institutions that anchor ancestry and territory are lost.
Fairly conducted trade lets benefit compound, while new family life and an opened market extend prosperity through both kinship and exchange.
Careless joking across a boundary becomes humiliation and punishment; an apparently minor offense awakens a stronger adversary and seeds later disaster.
Several rivers combine into a force beyond containment, destroying the royal center and interrupting the people’s access to food.
A great predator prepares to strike, but an unlikely smaller creature frightens it away, allowing the vulnerable herd to feed safely.
Formal preparation and southward travel meet favorable signs, generous hospitality, and appointment, turning readiness into recognized public responsibility.
Mountains sink, dry ground becomes aquatic, and both birds and people lose their dwellings; environmental reversal erases every ordinary refuge.
Blows arrive too quickly for recovery as battle spreads across the plain, yet the violent sequence ends with the opposing force overcome.
Solar emblems accompany an official who corrects wrongdoing within his own kin, showing impartial punishment while acknowledging the sorrow ruin leaves behind.
An elder travels east to negotiate peace and exchanges formal gifts through respected intermediaries, though a stray closing image introduces grief.
A mature tree generates many saplings from one maternal root, and its dense summer foliage shows abundance sustained through shared origin.
Balanced strength above and below supports fair government and public contentment, making the fortified community unattractive to attackers.
Expert help arrives from afar, yet the illness has passed beyond remedy and the state publicly acknowledges the ruler’s death.
A ceremonial imitation lacks the capacity of a real vehicle; when rulers rely on it for dangerous action, fear and inadequacy produce calamity.
Multiple forms of benefit gather around fertile land and a thriving settlement, with grain and rice arriving from their proper fields.
A principled guardian establishes discipline in public and family life, allowing joy, continuity, and many descendants to flourish under protection.
Rapid movement between capitals meets a market placed in unsuitable terrain; recognizing the mismatch and diverting prevents the error from becoming misfortune.
Cruel exemplars make the people suffer until they take up provisions and weapons, though the appended wedding imagery leaves the entry textually divided.
When higher sanction turns away from established power, movement shifts southward; measured ceremony restores public calm and brings armed struggle to a close.
Patient nesting and care sustain a harmonious family in which siblings mature well, find fitting places, and contribute to one another’s contentment.
A lost moment separates partners and leaves the traveler wandering far from family, converting delay into loneliness and durable regret.
Once root, trunk, and inner organs are corrupted, surface renewal cannot restore vitality and decline continues day by day.
Homes rise in widening rings around the ancestral mountain as many sons are born, linking population, place, and enduring local rule.
Two impaired creatures join forces, but shared limitation cannot create the missing ability, so their combined desire still remains unrealized.
Several hunters coordinate feints from both sides until the prey’s time runs out and every possible path has been sealed.
A tethered shot goes missing and mistrust turns even established divination into uncertainty; without confidence in evidence, danger cannot be clearly assessed.
An extraordinary mare covers immense distance along an even road, linking exceptional capacity with a journey free from obstruction or anxiety.
